register: Tableside provenance register (content rights, spec 7): launch sound and haptic cues

records.usedIn: Bundled in the app install and played by the audio/haptics service (apps/mobile/src/feedback) during practice play and, from spec 3, challenges. Not used in store materials.
records.origin: Original work. Synthesized from sine tones and seeded noise by apps/mobile/scripts/generate-cue-sounds.mjs in this repository, written by the implementing developer on 2026-10-20. No samples, recordings, sound libraries or AI generators were used; re-running the script reproduces every file byte for byte.
records.rightsBasis: Original work created for Tableside. No third-party material, license or paid asset.
records.usageLimits: None beyond the project's own: commercial app distribution, offline bundling and modification are permitted; no attribution is required.
records.changesAndValidation: File hashes, durations and catalog coverage are checked by apps/mobile/__tests__/cue-assets.test.ts. Rights approval is not a correctness result.

releaseReview.decision: Pending owner review before external distribution.

records.usedIn: Fired by the audio/haptics service through expo-haptics (apps/mobile/src/feedback/device-ports.ts).
records.origin: Standard platform patterns (selection; light, medium and heavy impact; success, warning and error notification) supplied by iOS and Android through expo-haptics. No haptic asset or custom pattern ships with the app.
records.rightsBasis: System-provided resources used through the platform APIs; the expo-haptics library is a software dependency under its own license, outside this content register.
records.changesAndValidation: The pairing is checked by apps/mobile/__tests__/feedback-service.test.ts and device-feedback-ports.test.ts. Android system-haptic behavior is measured on devices (spec 1 gate 8).

releaseReview.decision: Pending owner review before external distribution.
